name: Sonemi ~Houfuku no Shou~
source:
Famous private school. Heroine Mai is ordered to clean the principal's office after school together with a boy as a penalty for bad English grades. Mai has no intention to participate in cleaning, but she enjoys teasing her partner.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/09/vn-of-month-december-1997.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
一所著名的私立学校。女主角舞因英语成绩不好，被罚放学后和一个男生一起打扫校长室。舞完全没有打扫的意思，但她却很享受戏弄搭档。

[出自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/09/vn-of-month-december-1997.html]vndbreview[/url]]
